{{Quote| Kahfr's art is the art of people. Faces. Right now Mon Calamari faces. Taken out of context, a person's face can be quite abstract. This is what Kahfr does.|Kahfr Oladi|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''''Mon Calamari Eye 2''''' was an abstract [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was one of two paintings made by [[Kahfr Oladi]] that were put on display at the [[Museum of Tatooine/Legends|Museum of Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Painting of a Mon Calamari Eye 2'' was a painting in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
